title: Wire ScoringV2 into the session loop: FINAL_WAGER choice capture + SessionCounters feeds from mechanics
description: [RE-CREATED after working-tree cleaning deleted the untracked original] Integration gap identified by rev-c037 (TASK-037 review): the scoring layer (Barcade.Core.Scoring — FinalWager, BonusStarDraw, SessionCounters, FinalRanking) is pure and tested, but nothing in the session loop feeds it. Two wiring seams: (1) local SessionStateMachine's FinalWager state (SessionStateMachine.cs:253-259) is a 5 s timer-only stub with no per-seat 25/50/75 stick-choice capture — FinalWager.Resolve's null-choice=timeout-default(Half) API is already shaped for this; capture choices via the InputInterpreter during the FINAL_WAGER window and hand them plus final-microgame places to the pot resolution. (2) Nothing calls SessionCounters.Record* (eliminations, weapons used, Zen metric, REACCIONA latency, invested, robbed) from the mechanics/loop — define where each counter feed lives (microgame results vs session events) and wire the ones Hito 2 can already observe; [ASSUMED]-tag and stub the ones whose source systems (arsenal, robbery) do not exist yet. GDD §6.2/§6.3. Depends on TASK-024 (FSM) and TASK-037 (scoring) being merged.
acceptance_criteria: FINAL_WAGER captures per-seat 25/50/75 stick choices during its 5 s window via the InputInterpreter; absent choice resolves to the timeout default; pot resolution runs on FINAL_MG completion with exact GDD 6.2 math (pinned by test through the FSM path)

SessionCounters receives real feeds for every counter whose source system exists at Hito 2 (at minimum REACCIONA best-latency and microgame-win/elimination-style counters); counters whose source systems do not yet exist are stubbed and [ASSUMED]-tagged with the owning future ticket named
GAME_OVER ranks via FinalRanking (estrellas -> monedas -> victorias -> shared podium) using the drawn bonus stars; deterministic replay test through the full FSM path
Tests-first for the FSM-visible behavior; fast suite green, no regression

comments.author: developer
comments.body: Delivered tests-first on master by dev-t101: 2c44d2a test(core) red (8 tests; compile-red CS1061 on every new public member, captured by temporarily reverting SessionStateMachine.cs to d652d73 state and running the suite; restored before the next commit) -> 0d1b052 feat(core). Suite 530 -> 538/538; all 23 pre-existing SessionStateMachineTests pass UNMODIFIED despite a substantial rewrite. AC1: FinalWager reads the machine's own InputInterpreter (the T-101 seam's second consumer, as designed); [ASSUMED] gesture mapping Left=25/Up=50/Right=75, Down unused (GDD 6.2 names no directions; 3 choices on 4 cardinals, double-mapping rejected as less honest); choice sticky per seat across neutral ticks (tracked in the FSM — the interpreter reports only current-tick direction); pot resolution once on FinalMg completion, pinned two ways (exact stakes through the FSM + field-by-field match vs an independent FinalWager.Resolve call). AC2: Gatillo = only real counter feed today (Reacciona is the only v2 mechanic with a latency-shaped Metric); MicrogameWins fed (competitive place-1 or coop success, climax included; the FinalRanking tiebreak); Kamikaze/Cangreja/Inversora/Fantasma unfed ([ASSUMED], board-tile-driven, TASK-042 territory); Zen unfed ([ASSUMED], pending the human GDD line-496 fix) — all sit at honest zero/tied defaults. AC3: BonusStarDraw + FinalRanking wired, pinned by independently recomputing Rank from the FSM's own stars/coins/wins. Determinism: full attract->game-over replay with wager gestures, two runs compared exactly. TWO JUDGMENT CALLS FLAGGED: (1) baseStars always 0 — GDD 5.3's pre-bonus star sources are board-tile events, BoardModel still a stub; documented prominently, honest zero baseline until Hito 4; does not weaken the exclusion rule (TASK-037 tests cover varied baseStars). (2) SCOPE ADDITION: regular (non-climax) rounds apply PayoutRules' GDD-DEFAULT tables (6/4/2/1 competitive, 4/1 coop) — without it Coins stay zero and FINAL_WAGER's pot is trivially degenerate, hollowing AC1; no per-definition payoutTable is threaded through IMicrogame/SetActiveMicrogame yet. ALSO: BonusStarDraw's seed derived by consuming the FIRST draw from the constructor's SeededRandom at construction (before any microgame touches it) — kept the constructor signature unchanged, zero call-site churn.

comments.author: rev-t051
comments.body:
FULL review verdict (diff 323fcc4..0d1b052, suite 538/538 verified firsthand in detached worktree): APPROVE-WITH-NITS — 0 HIGH, 3 MEDIUM, 3 LOW. Merge-eligible after a light fix round; nothing requires production-logic changes.

MEDIUM-1 (test adequacy): documented wager-capture semantics unpinned. Class doc (SessionStateMachine.cs:79-93) promises last-held-wins + sticky-across-neutral; TickFinalWager (581-604) implements via per-seat latch, but no test pins (i) later gesture overrides earlier (25->75), (ii) choose-then-release-to-neutral keeps choice, (iii) Down/None are no-ops (Down-holder resolves to timeout default). A "first choice wins" refactor would pass the whole suite while contradicting the contract. Fix: 2-3 small tests through the existing stakes path; optionally pin "gesture during Intermission doesn't count" (currently true by construction only).

MEDIUM-2: default-payout scope addition is legitimate and load-bearing ([ASSUMED]-documented at SessionStateMachine.cs:95-116, coop-vs-competitive detection exhaustive over ResultKind), BUT the future per-definition payoutTable threading has NO named owner — no ticket owns threading payoutTable through IMicrogame/SetActiveMicrogame (TASK-042 owns board/arsenal, not this). Fix: file the follow-up ticket and name it in the class-doc paragraph.

MEDIUM-3 (scrutinized hardest): first-draw seed acquisition (_scoringSeed = _rng.NextInt(int.MinValue,int.MaxValue) at construction, line 261) is mechanically sound — NextInt long-math+rejection safe at extreme range; SeededRandom cannot surface its seed so this was the only deterministic option without a signature change; consumption site uses the canonical TASK-044 Derive idiom (BonusStarDraw.cs:125), so NOT a third stream-derivation idiom, a seed-plumbing workaround one level up; rng-stream shift has zero consumers (verified: no non-test constructors, no pinned FSM-forwarded rng values in 323fcc4 tests); determinism pinned by full-path replay test. Residual: a new unnamed idiom for obtaining a session seed, NOT [ASSUMED]-tagged, and must migrate when a real int sessionSeed is threaded through the session (replay-format break for a given construction seed). Fix: minimum = tag the "Scoring seed derivation" para [ASSUMED] + name the owning migration ticket; better = add a constructor overload taking int sessionSeed now. Acceptable-with-documentation, not blocking.

LOW-1: Gatillo feed (509-516) records CUMULATIVE tick-latency across tandas as "ms", including the 1,000,000-tick failure sentinel (~16.7M "ms"). Ordering across seats stays correct so WinnerOf is sound, but the stored mean is not a human-meaningful latency — GDD §15 telemetry or a future HUD would display nonsense. Fix: normalize per tanda or document at the feed site that only ordering is meaningful.

LOW-2: class-doc zero-alloc para (209-214) claims Tick-path allocations are once-per-session, but CaptureResult allocates new int[4] per regular ranked round end (521). Behavior fine (same accepted class as GetResult's per-round allocation the old doc cited); doc overstates.

LOW-3 (claim precision, no action): "all 23 pre-existing tests byte-UNMODIFIED" — the test commit has 2 deletions in the shared FakeMicrogame fixture (ctor gained optional MicrogameId, Id became auto-property). All 23 pre-existing test METHODS untouched and passing. Recording the accurate claim here.

POSITIVE VERIFICATIONS: red evidence reproduced firsthand (2c44d2a test-only, CS1061 on exactly the six new members; SessionStateMachine.cs byte-identical d652d73..323fcc4, so the dev's revert-capture narrative is equivalent); commit order tests-then-impl verified, tier honored. AC1 pinned two ways incl. integer-floor edge + timeout default (GDD §6.2 cross-checked: 25/50/75 palanca 5s, split 50/30/15/5 matches FinalWager). AC2 Gatillo min-direction over mean verified from source (GDD §6.3 "Mejor latencia media" — dev matched GDD over ticket wording); MicrogameWins semantics pinned; unfed counters honestly grant nothing; Zen-row GDD truncation independently confirmed at line ~496. AC3 FinalRanking chain matches §6.3 desempate exactly; GameOver test independently recomputes Rank. Replay test genuinely full-path with wager gestures + all new fields. Input boundary: TickFinalWager never ticks the microgame; pre-existing boundary pins unmodified and passing. Zero-alloc sensor not vacuous (liveness-bracketed, payouts outside window, Nullable<WagerChoice> struct). Recurring HIGH classes swept: climax double-payout ruled out and arithmetically pinned; double-capture per round mutually exclusive via _phase guard; degenerate climax documented [ASSUMED]. Flagged calls judged: (a) legitimate, edge semantics unpinned -> MEDIUM-1; (b) baseStars=0 correct and honest, approve as-is; (c) legitimate enabling scope -> MEDIUM-2; (d) sound, needs [ASSUMED] + named owner -> MEDIUM-3.
